Feature.Description:
A SiLA Server for controlling the Automated Thermal Cycler (ATC) made by Thermo Fisher Scientific.
The Automated Thermal Cycler is a small, easy-to-integrate thermal cycler. It supports 96‑well and 0.2‑mL sample block configuration (compatible with full‑ or half‑skirted plates). Model number : A31487 Product URL : https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/A31487 Firmware Version: v1.2.0

Command.Description:
Load the protocol file.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command load.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes: Same as the status at the start of execution

Parameter.Description: Protocol file in binary form. The original protocol file is expected to be in XML format. Note: The file must be encoded in UTF-8.

Command.Description:
Validate the protocol file.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command validate.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes: Same as the status at the start of execution

Parameter.Description: Upper limit of sample volume. If set to 0, the default value is used.

Command.Description:
Open the lid of the ATC.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command openLid.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error

Close the lid of the ATC.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command closeLid.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error

Start to run using the already loaded protocol file. Note: Execute the following commands in advance. * Load * Validate * Close Lid
Calling this command invokes the instrument command startRun, getElapsedTime, getRemainingTime.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Running Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Running If an error occurs: Error Note: After the protocol finishes, the status is updated according to the result: Normal completion: Idle Error occurred: Error

Stop running. If this command is sent when the instrument is not running, an error occurs.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command stopRun.
Status required to execute this command: Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error Note: After stop running, the status is updated according to the result: Normal completion: Idle Error occurred: Error

Get the state of the instrument.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command getInstrumentState.
Status required to execute this command: Idle, Running, Error Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Same as the status at the start of execution If an error occurs: Error

Response.Description: The state of the instrument. 0: IDLE 1: STANDBY 2: RUNNING 3: ERROR 4: DIAGNOSTICS

Command.Description:
Reset the server to its Idle state. This command is common to all instruments.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command stopRun.
Status required to execute this command: Error Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Automated Thermal Cycler (ATC) is not initialized. The possible causes are as follows: * ATC is not connected to the PC running AutomatedThermalCyclerController. * The configuration for ATC (ex. HostName) is incorrect.
An error occurred on the instrument during command execution. Inspect the instrument.
The instrument is not in a valid status to accept the specified command.
Protocol file has not been loaded.
Protocol file has been loaded but not validated.

Property.Description: The elapsed time since the protocol started running, represented as a string in hh:mm:ss format. If the protocol is not running, the value is set to 00:00:00.

The remaining time until the protocol completes, represented as a string in hh:mm:ss format. If the protocol is not running, the value is set to 00:00:00.
Note: Until the protocol finishes, the value will not be set to 00:00:00. Instead, the value will stop at 00:00:01.
Returns the status of the instrument. This property is common to all instruments. 0: Not Connected 1: Idle 2: Running 3: Error
